sections.title: Inputs And Determinism
sections.text: occurrences required nonempty array of {ref, axis:[x,y,z] unitless, distance:length-expression, phase?:name, label?:text}. A parent occurrence carries its nested content natively; instances are moved, never loose body copies. phases optional ordered names (equal time slices); unphased occurrences join the last phase. disconnections optional {name?, from, to} precedence edges: from must explode in an earlier phase than to. duration required positive seconds (number or '<n> s'/'<n> ms'); fps required positive integer; easing optional linear|smoothstep|easeIn|easeOut|easeInOut (default linear). schemaVersion required 1. Read-only.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: Enveloped result (schemaVersion 1): status:pass|fail, operation:explode.plan, documentIdentity, units:{length:cm,time:s}, frame:{space:root,component}, associativity:snapshot, method, limitations, provenance, affected:[occurrence refs], result:{order:[{ref,label,phase,phaseIndex}],phaseSchedule:[{name,startTime,endTime,frameStart,frameEnd}],frameCount,durationSeconds,fps,frameDurationSeconds,easing,poses:[{index,timeSeconds,occurrences:[{ref,label,phase,origin:[x,y,z],axis,distance,fraction}]}],trails:[{ref,label,points}],balloons:[{ref,label,position}],blockers:[],cycles:[],nativeStoryboardActionsCreated:false,explodeIsNotServicePath:true}. status is fail when disconnection precedence is violated (blockers) or a precedence cycle exists (cycles).

examples.label: Cock Release Return Cover Lift
examples.requires: Open Design document with occurrences resolvable from occ-cover/occ-pcb tokens.
examples.output: result.frameCount is 61 (floor(2*30)+1); result.order lists cover (release) before pcb (return); result.phaseSchedule preserves cock, release, return order.

examples.label: Disconnection Order Violation Is Fail
examples.requires: Two occurrences in the same phase with a from->to disconnection between them.
examples.output: result.status is fail and result.blockers has one entry; no mutation is performed (read-only).

verified: deterministic per-frame origin interpolation with easing

sections.title: Inputs And Safety
sections.text: Same schedule inputs as explode.plan plus confirm required true. restore optional boolean default true: restore original occurrence transforms in finally; false leaves the final exploded pose. frameFiles optional exactly frameCount nonexisting .png paths, or directory+prefix (creates prefix-000.png etc.); no overwrite, no directory creation. width/height optional PNG size (default 1280x720). schemaVersion required 1. The handler moves occurrence transforms (instances), never loose body copies; a moving parent occurrence carries its nested content natively.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: Enveloped result (schemaVersion 1): status:pass|fail, operation:explode.render, documentIdentity, units, frame, associativity:recipeRegeneration, method, limitations, provenance, affected:[occurrence refs], result:explode.plan fields plus frameFiles:[paths], error:null|string, restoreRequested:boolean, restored:boolean|null, restoreErrors:[]. status is fail when the primary motion/export failed or restoration was requested and failed; the original error is preserved and restoreErrors are reported separately. Completed frame exports remain on failure.

examples.label: Render And Restore A Cover Explode
examples.requires: Open Design document; occ-cover resolves to a movable occurrence and the model is restored afterward.
examples.output: result.frameCount is 11; result.restored is true; the cover occurrence returns to its original transform after rendering.

examples.label: Restore Leaves Final Pose When Disabled
examples.requires: Open Design document; a single occurrence exploded with restore disabled.
examples.output: result.restoreRequested is false and result.restored is null; the occurrence is left at the final exploded pose.

verified: occurrence transform application and restoration in finally
restore failure reported separately with the original error preserved
